product_overview: hex-yt-intel is a YouTube video-intelligence SaaS that transforms a submitted video URL into a structured AI analysis. Users can review the synthesized report, explore extracted entities and relationships, and ask grounded questions about the analyzed video.
core_goals: Submit a YouTube video for AI-powered analysis
Review the streamed multi-part analysis results
Explore entities and relationships from the analyzed video
Ask questions grounded in the analysis content
Manage account access and subscription status
Share an analysis publicly through a secure link

features.name: Video Analysis Submission
features.description: Users submit a YouTube URL to start a cached-or-fresh analysis and receive progressively streamed results across multiple dimensions.
user_flows: Navigate to /dashboard -> Paste a YouTube URL -> Submit the analysis request -> Watch live progress as dimensions stream in -> View the completed executive digest and analysis cards
Navigate to /dashboard -> Paste a previously analyzed YouTube URL -> Submit the analysis request -> See the cached result return immediately or near-immediately -> Review the analysis output

features.name: Knowledge Graph and Entity Visualization
features.description: Users explore extracted entities through interactive graph and word-cloud views and can inspect relationships from the analysis.
user_flows: Navigate to /dashboard -> Open the graph visualization -> Explore entity relationships in the canvas -> Click an entity node -> Seek the video to the associated timestamp
Navigate to /dashboard -> Switch between graph and word-cloud views -> Hover an entity for more detail -> Inspect the extracted concepts from the analysis

features.name: Chat Grounded in Analysis
features.description: Users ask questions about a completed analysis and receive answers grounded only in that video's content.
user_flows: Navigate to /dashboard -> Open the chat panel -> Type a question about the analyzed video -> Send the message -> Read the streamed grounded reply
Navigate to /dashboard -> Open the chat panel -> Start a new conversation -> Ask a follow-up question -> Review the conversation history

features.name: Authentication
features.description: Users sign in with Google OAuth to access authenticated areas of the product.
user_flows: Navigate to /auth/signin -> Choose Google sign-in -> Complete authentication -> Arrive in the dashboard after successful login
Navigate to /auth/signin -> Choose Google sign-in -> Cancel or fail the sign-in attempt -> See the authentication error page

features.name: Billing and Subscription Management
features.description: Users view plan details, usage, and upgrade paths, then complete subscription management through Paddle.
user_flows: Navigate to /billing -> Review current plan and usage quota -> Choose an upgrade path -> Complete Paddle checkout -> Return with the updated subscription state
Navigate to /billing -> Review subscription details -> Choose to cancel the subscription -> Confirm the cancellation request -> See the subscription status update

features.name: Saved Analyses Browsing
features.description: Users search, reopen, and manage previously generated analyses from their saved history.
user_flows: Navigate to /analyses/saved -> Review the saved analysis list -> Search by keyword -> Open a matching analysis to revisit the results
Navigate to /analyses/saved -> Review the saved analysis list -> Remove an analysis from history -> See it disappear from the list
Navigate to /search -> Search for a prior analysis -> Select a matching result -> Reopen the analysis

features.name: Shared Analysis Public View
features.description: Anyone with a signed share link can view a read-only version of an analysis without signing in.
user_flows: Open a shared /share/[token] link -> View the read-only analysis page -> Read the shared report content

features.name: Waitlist Signup
features.description: Visitors can join the waitlist for gated or upcoming features by submitting an email address.
user_flows: Navigate to /waitlist -> Enter an email address -> Submit the form -> See the confirmation message

features.name: Marketing and Product Information Pages
features.description: Visitors can review pricing, founders, and legal information before deciding to sign up or subscribe.
user_flows: Navigate to /pricing -> Review the available plans and feature differences -> Compare tiers -> Decide whether to sign up or upgrade
Navigate to /founders -> Review the founders information -> Learn about the product background
Navigate to /privacy-policy -> Read the privacy policy -> Review legal terms and data handling information

tech_stack: Cloudflare Workers (LLM streaming backend, separate service)

routes.description: Landing page, video URL input to start analysis
Main analysis workspace, live SSE streaming of dimensions/entities
Cross-analysis knowledge graph / second-brain wiki view
Public shared-analysis view via signed token

features.name: Video Analysis Submission

user_interactions: Paste a YouTube URL into the input field
Watch live streaming progress of analysis dimensions
View completed dimension cards (executive digest, entities, knowledge graph, word cloud)

features.name: Knowledge Graph / Entity Visualization
features.description: Interactive force-directed graph and word cloud of extracted entities from an analysis, entity click seeks video timestamp
user_interactions: Click an entity node to seek video playback

features.name: Chat Grounded in Analysis
features.description: Chat interface answering questions strictly grounded in a completed analysis; refuses if no usable analysis exists
user_interactions: Type a question about the analyzed video
Send message and view streamed reply

features.name: Billing / Subscription Management
features.description: Paddle-based checkout and subscription management, quota display

features.name: Saved Analyses Browsing
features.description: List, search, and reopen previously generated analyses
user_interactions: Click an analysis card to reopen it

features.name: Shared Analysis Public View
features.description: View a shared analysis via a signed public token link, no auth required

features.name: Admin Console
features.description: Internal admin tools for settings registry, logs, parity review, and stats
